node_definition.done_when: Context: nova/equilibrium/forward_operator.py holds the support clip mode in the global _SUPPORT_CLIP_MODE, set by set_support_clip_mode and read by support_clip_mode. The operator carries its own mode through ForwardFluxOperator.with_clip_mode (forward_operator.py:2732), and a request carries it through ForwardSolveRequest(clip_mode=...). benchmarks/solovev_certificate.py is imported by 29 of the 43 files that still set the global, so it migrates first. Rules: (a) every internal set-and-restore pair (solovev_certificate.py:3172, 3284-3362, 4146-4175, 4321-4348, 4361-4368, 4378-4425, and measure.py:1037-1043 and 1079-1085) becomes explicit threading of that mode to each operator (with_clip_mode), profile and request (clip_mode=) built inside, so no global is set; (b) every helper that builds an operator, profile or request and that other files import (for example _certificate_solve_request at :2189, _case, _case_machine, _closed_form_current_target) gains a keyword clip_mode: str | None = None, where None keeps today's behaviour exactly (operator mode left unset, request mode omitted) and a concrete value is applied; (c) existing call signatures stay valid, so changes are additive keywords only; (d) a receipt that records a mode records the mode the solving operator actually used, never support_clip_mode(). (2) Every test module that imports either file, run with JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu and -m 'not slow' in one fresh pytest process per file in place on this fleet allocation, adds no failure against the dispatch base. Build the base tree with git archive of the base revision extracted under /tmp and run it with PYTHONPATH pointing there and the shared interpreter /home/ITER/mcintos/Code/nova/.venv/bin/python, because .git/worktrees is read-only in this fence. Keep all logs under the run directory. Every uv command carries --no-sync and nothing runs uv sync. Write the manifest before any long step; its status is one of complete, blocked or failed.
